orientation.basis: The wide composition is landscape-oriented, but all prominent Latin text has level horizontal baselines and reads left-to-right without rotation.

blindPixelObservations: Wide landscape frame dominated by dark navy, teal, black, and rust-orange tones.

A very large translucent blue-white rounded form occupies the center-right, enclosing multiple elongated vertical orange-brown shapes. Its upper rim is intensely white and irregular, with vertical glow streaks.

A second, smaller bright-rimmed rounded form appears at lower right. Dark curved and angular forms fill the left and outer edges, while numerous small pale fragments and colored square-like light points are scattered through the scene.

The lower region contains a narrow near-black title plaque overlapping a larger near-black body panel. Both have stepped or clipped corners, thin bronze/gold outlines, and orange diagonal border accents.
A compact blue-white composite glyph followed by 2+ is centered just above the title plaque.
The title is one centered line of large white uppercase text. The body is three centered lines of white mixed-case text, followed by one centered orange uppercase line near the panel bottom.
The orange diagonal marks along the panel sides are physically integrated into the border geometry and do not appear as independently enclosed symbols.

uncertainties: The blue-white glyph's semantic identity is not established by any printed label; its upright element could visually resemble a rounded figure, bottle, pawn, or flame-like marker.
The narrow dark division at the bottom of the white upright element may separate two projections or may partly result from blue glow and outlining.
The large glowing rounded forms in the background have textured, irregular boundaries and are treated as illustration rather than promoted to functional symbols.
The orange diagonal panel accents appear border-integrated and are not promoted to functional symbols.
MISSION TASK occurs once at lower center; it is represented in both typeLine and lowerCenter to encode its apparent role and its visible position, not as two separate printed instances.
